description:
A day trader specializing in momentum scalping needs to set up Time & Sales (T&S) windows in NinjaTrader 8 to monitor the order flow tape for SPY and AAPL.

Your task is to create two Time & Sales windows in NinjaTrader 8:
1. Open a new Time & Sales window and configure it for instrument 'SPY'.
2. Open a second Time & Sales window and configure it for instrument 'AAPL'.
3. Configure BOTH windows to display exactly 100 rows of trade data (this setting is often found in the Properties dialog).
4. Save the workspace to ensure the configuration is persisted.

Starting State: NinjaTrader 8 is open. Historical data for SPY and AAPL is available.
